caption: The drawing depicts a square flag with loops at each of the four corners, the bottom right loop from which a long, light-colored tassel is attached. The flag has a gradient background, ranging from light brown and tan shades to a slightly duller brown at the outer edges, with some subtle grayish tinting. Centered on the flag is the image of a sitting stag, rendered in dark brown with specks of lighter and darker shades to suggest texture and detail, and outlined in black. The stag is shown with prominent antlers and its head turned to the left. The flag itself has a dark border, and the overall composition is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Cushion Top
